You want to contribute to LifeOS AI? Follow this process.

1. Find an existing issue <br>
   ↓ <br>
2. Comment that you want to work on it <br>
   ↓ <br>
3. Fork the repository<br>
   ↓ <br>
4. Create a new branch<br>
   ↓ <br>
5. Implement the changes<br>
   ↓ <br>
6. Run the tests<br>
   ↓ <br>
7. Push your branch<br>
   ↓ <br>
8. Open a Pull Request<br>
   ↓ <br>
9. Wait for maintainer review<br>
   ↓ <br>
10. Address requested changes / approval<br>
   ↓ <br>
11. Ensure CI checks pass<br>
   ↓ <br>
12. Merge the changes
